newsitem.title: ITALY: PRESS DIGEST - ITALY - THURSDAY SEPTEMBER 5.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - ITALY - THURSDAY SEPTEMBER 5.

text.p: Following are some of the top headlines in Italy's leading newspapers.
*U.S. attacks on Iraq send Italian petrol prices higher.(All)

*After resignations of Olivetti chairman Carlo De Benedetti and director general Renzo Francesconi, market regulator Consob calls emergency meeting with Olivetti officials after Francesconi makes comments on Olivetti's half year figures.
*Along with unions, health minister Rosy Bindi is opposed to government plans to make patients pay "tickets" for hospital care. (Stampa,Repubblica)
*Term for current board of Banco Di Sicilia to expire soon, meeting to renew it expected next week but no agreement over successors yet seen among controlling parties.(Il sole)
*Prices for supplementary fares on train tickets will not increase, government says.(Il Sole)
Reuters has not verified these stories and not vouch for their accuracy.
